answer: In a decentralized agent economy, sybil resistance can come from requiring each agent to stake a unique resource tied to real-world scarcity, such as compute proven via a timed puzzle that only genuine hardware can solve efficiently. Imagine navigating a digital tundra where a sudden gale of false identities would extinguish any weak claim; only those holding a verified lantern of continuous uptime and stake history survive peer scrutiny and earn attestation.
